name: bbox_expand_to_corners
description: BBox::ExpandToCorners expands a min/max bbox into the original eight-corner packet order.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this helper; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zClass DI/source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x446ed0 validates fastcall inputs in ecx/edx, no direct callees, and the exact min/max field copy order for all eight zBBoxCorners entries.
The native smoke verifies representative corners from the min-y, max-y, min-z, and max-z groups in the expanded packet.
